findings.shape: Two selected depressed caps have shorter thick eccentric stems, dark basal cues, rolled thinner margins and a coarse angular lower pore field. Polyporus squamosus is a synonym, not an additional species.
findings.surface: Buff caps bear varied raised brown radial/concentric scale patches. Numeric pore relief, muted stem pigment and dark bases remain on the same geometry across display actions.
findings.movement: Stationary retained caps and stipes with an enlarged spore-drift illustration; no growth, wood-decay physiology or measured discharge.
findings.evidenceScope: Actual Dan Molter Ohio/elm photograph compared with Naturalis under Polyporus squamosus and specialist Kew/Index Fungorum name records. The source-labelled photograph is not a new specimen determination.
corrections: Replaced flat identical polygon motifs with varied raised patches and reduced exaggerated vertical cap rims.
findings.residual: Scale placement still has visible concentric regularity, depressions and rolled margins are simplified, and the cap/stipe proportions are unmeasured. Decurrent pore architecture, fine hyphae, tissue optics and host attachment remain partial.
